title: GL.iNet Router Syslog Severity Leaderboard
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glinet:syslog severity=*
| stats sum(severity) as total_value, avg(severity) as avg_value by facility
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks facility values by total and average severity across GL.iNet router syslog events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `severity` values for each GL.iNet router syslog event and review total and average severity by facility.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total severity.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily which facility shows the biggest severity numbers in your GL.iNet router syslog data.
